witness_description: Let f(s) = -2 and g(s) = -1. Then |min(f(s),g(s))| = 2, but |min(|f(s)|,|g(s)|)| = 1.
refutation_explanation: With x = f(s) = -2 and y = g(s) = -1, the left side is abs(min(-2,-1)) = 2, while the right side is abs(min(abs(-2),abs(-1))) = 1. Since 2 != 1, the claimed equality fails.
search_space: All 25 ordered integer pairs (x, y) in {-2, -1, 0, 1, 2}^2, in lexicographic product order; every pair was evaluated exactly once.
